intent: A value is stated, silently shifted two turns later, then the user asks what is on record — the trail of beliefs must surface both.
prompt: Remember: the offsite is at the lakeside lodge.

followups.prompt: Name one benefit of writing meeting notes right after a call.
The offsite venue is the downtown conference centre.
Remind me where the offsite is.

grader.regex: (?=[\s\S]*lodge)(?=[\s\S]*(conference|downtown))|conflict|contradict|inconsist|does ?n[o']t (match|line up|add up)|differ|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|previously|before you|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|go(es)? against|violat|not (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft|order)

note: Pass = the final summary reports both values or flags that two venues were given. Fail = states only one value as if it were settled. [AL1c probe: semantic_contradiction / belief-trail (world-model belief trail).]
